saints.name: The Dedication of the Lateran Basilica
saints.title: The Mother Church of Rome and of the World
saints.shortBlurb: The feast of the Lateran, cathedral of the Bishop of Rome and mother of all the churches of the city and the world…
biography: This feast honours the dedication of the Basilica of the Most Holy Saviour and of Sts. John the Baptist and John the Evangelist at the Lateran, the cathedral church of the Pope as Bishop of Rome. An inscription on its façade names it the mother and head of all the churches of the city and of the world.

The basilica arose in the fourth century on land given by the Emperor Constantine and was long the residence of the popes. Its feast, kept throughout the Western Church, is a celebration of the unity of the whole Church around the See of Peter rather than of any one saint.
saints.knownFor: The cathedral of the Pope, mother of all churches.
